question: After the RFC structure is repaired, should OpenClaw accept the revised one-package/one-new-agent Claws contract and migrate the experimental prototype stack to it?
rationale: The branch defines broad permanent product and compatibility surfaces and redirects already-merged experimental work; document correctness cannot resolve whether that contract should become OpenClaw policy.

options.title: Accept and restack
options.body: Approve the central contract, define prototype migration and scoped deferrals, create the implementation issue, and mark the RFC accepted.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC draft open while maintainers resolve additional contract, portability, and migration details.

options.title: Decline first-class Claws
options.body: Reject the product surface and plan containment or removal of the experimental prototypes.

recommendation.title: Accept and restack
recommendation.body: Approve the central contract, define prototype migration and scoped deferrals, create the implementation issue, and mark the RFC accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the repository's governing RFC process and has the strongest repository-wide history for routing the final acceptance gate.
